places.name: Syndicate
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roaster in Leipzig with Instagram presence. Minimal online detail but identified in specialty coffee community.

places.name: Röstkollektiv Gera
places.editorialNote: Dedicated coffee roastery (Röstkollektiv). Self-roasts selection of coffees from various origins. Serves espresso & filter.

places.name: KaffeeWerk
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery & cafe with trained barista. Offers multiple brew methods (french press, aero press, espresso, americano). Listed in European Coffee Trip specialty guide.

places.name: Buena Vida Coffee Roasters
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery with own roasting in Potsdam-Babelsberg. Focuses on regenerative certified coffees from Costa Rica. Offers espresso, filter, courses. Established 2014.

places.name: Kolumbianische Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Colombian coffee roastery featuring Caventura beans. Limited website info on roasting methods, but name and bean selection indicate specialty focus.

places.name: Teehaus Winsen (Luhe)
places.editorialNote: Tea-focused shop offering large selection of special coffee varieties plus chocolates and accessories. Not a roastery but curates specialty beans.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Eiderstedt
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery with long-duration gentle roasting (220C, ~20min). Diverse single-origin sourcing: Costa Rica, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ethiopia, India, Brazil. House blends like Eggis Bester and Eggis Espresso. Daily fresh roasting.

places.name: Detmolder Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Award-winning specialty roastery. Der Feinschmecker award-winner 3x (2018, 2022, 2025). 8 gold medals German Roasters Guild. Light/medium roasts, 15 single origins from Africa/Central America/Asia. Direct roasting on-site.

places.name: Halbstark
places.editorialNote: Specialty café & roastery founded 2016 (mobile), permanent location 2018, roasting since Jan 2024. Light roasting, single origins from Africa/Latin America/Brazil. Monthly subscription 'interludes'. Coffee workshops.

places.name: Brando Coffee
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery and coffeelounge. Fair-trade Arabica from El Salvador, robusta-free. Espresso-focused, handmade pastries. Website under renovation (captured via search).

places.name: Lais Espressostudio
places.editorialNote: Espresso studio with quality focus. Owner Lais Etemadi: 30 yrs gastronomy experience, 7 yrs self-employed coffee passion. Latte art, specialty espresso, handmade pastries. Also sells coffee beans and repairs machines.

places.name: Kosterei
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery & café opened Jan 2021. Small-batch drum roasting, gentle air cooling. 4 single-origin bio coffees: Brazil, Peru, Guatemala, Colombia. Stefan Kurlovich owner. Roasts Mondays only.

places.name: Arabica
places.editorialNote: Coffee culture specialist 20 years, over 30 locally roasted coffee varieties, described as highest coffee quality. Featured for espresso excellence.

places.name: Kaffeesack
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery since 2018. Traditional drum roasting, direct farm relationships, third-wave credentials. Featured on European Coffee Trip and 3wcc specialty roasters directory.

places.name: Bienvenue
places.editorialNote: Coffee roastery with excellent specialty credentials mentioned. Tripadvisor lists as coffee roastery with specialty focus and excellent reviews for coffee quality.

places.name: Kaffeesack
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery established 2019. Traditional drum roasting, third-wave focus. Featured on European Coffee Trip, recommended by specialty roasters directory.

places.name: Mulembe Kaffee
places.editorialNote: Own roastery importing & roasting Ugandan specialty coffee. Cupping score 85+. Direct trade from Mount Elgon. Featured in European Coffee Trip guide. Research-backed farm partnerships.

places.name: Taza Azul
places.editorialNote: Own roastery since 2021. Specialty coffee from Mexican cloud forests (Nebelwälder). Direct trade, sustainable cultivation. Single-origin parcels. Freshly roasted in-house.

places.name: Cafe M
places.editorialNote: Own roastery (Rösterei Weilheim). Coffee roaster & cafe. Martin Hülsmann operates roastery with handmade cakes. Active on Instagram with roasting content.

places.name: mi cafecito - Bio-Kaffee-Spezialitäten
places.editorialNote: Bio coffee roastery since 1999 with own roasting, fair trade certified, single-origin & blend espressos, weekly hand roasting.

places.name: Rösterei Cabresso
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery serving exclusively specialty-grade beans, slow drum roasting max 210°C, hand-roasted small batches, inclusive social enterprise.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Baum
places.editorialNote: Established roastery 2008+ with single-origin specialty coffees, hand-roasted since 2008, light & medium roasts, tasting events offered.

places.name: Kaffeemone
places.editorialNote: Premium hand-roasted coffee since 2007, small-batch roasting, subscription service, specialty focus with variety of roast profiles.

places.name: Like Rösterei
places.editorialNote: Own artisan roastery since 2017. Handcraft drum roasting, multi-origin coffees (Brazil, Ethiopia, etc.), espresso and filter blends. Flagship location in Brunswick city center.

places.name: Contigo Fairtrade
places.editorialNote: Fair-trade specialist with own roastery. Fresh-roasted organic fair-trade coffees. Primary focus on ethical sourcing and in-house roasting. Small café setting.

places.name: röst.art
places.editorialNote: Own specialty roastery in pedestrian zone. Modern minimalist café with passionate focus on quality coffee. Specialty coffees, espresso-focused, active on specialty coffee community.

places.name: Three Years One Day Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery sourcing SCA-rated (80+) specialty coffees. Clearly third-wave focused. Small batch roasting, environmental consciousness (package-free initiative). Roasts high-quality green beans intentionally.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Kaffeehimmel & Co
places.editorialNote: Bio-Manufaktur with own drum roastery. Direct-trade single-origin beans, low-temp roasting, coffee school courses. Fair trade, sustainable focus.

places.name: ODIBA Coffee
places.editorialNote: Artisanal coffee roastery operating since 1898. Own roastery, Deutsche Röstergilde Gold 2026 award, hand-roasted specialty beans, single-origins.

places.name: ODIBA Coffee
places.editorialNote: Cafe/shop front for ODIBA Kaffeerösterei. Hand-roasted specialty beans, German Roasters Guild recognised, own roastery since 1898.

places.name: Lapuzia Kaffee
places.editorialNote: Dedicated coffee roastery in Solingen since 2010. Hand-roasted specialty beans, single-origins, educated approach to brewing. Freshness guarantee.

places.name: Kaffeehaus m
places.address: Alter Frankfurter Weg 80, 63165 Mühlheim am Main
places.editorialNote: Member of German Coffee Association (Deutscher Kaffeeverbandst). Roasts and sells specialty beans from around the world. No direct cafe service.

places.name: Don Grano
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee manufacturer (Kaffeemanufaktur) focused exclusively on Colombian single-origin. Hand-picked beans, small batch roasting with passion for quality.

places.name: Café Liebich
places.editorialNote: Multiroaster specialty coffee shop. Rotating guest roasters (DAK, La Cabra, People Possession). Light roasts, single-origin focus, curated online+offline. Serious coffee selection.

places.name: Caligo Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery with retail shop on main road. Fresh specialty coffee roasted in-house, filter and project coffees, multiple origins, gift items and equipment.

places.name: Caligo Coffee
places.editorialNote: Café operated by Caligo roastery. Serves their fresh-roasted specialty coffees on-site. Espresso, filter, sandwiches, cakes. Direct outlet for house roastery.

places.name: Junker's Kaffee-Rösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery (Rösterei) with café. 9 coffee varieties, fair-trade emphasis, barista courses, equipment specialist. Quality-focused espresso and filter preparation.

places.name: Tangermünder Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery in-house. Roasts beans fresh, offers multiple origins/varieties. Knowledgeable owner leads tastings. Sells wholesale online.

places.name: MajaKaffee
places.editorialNote: Dedicated roastery with gentle roast philosophy. Direct trade from Costa Rica farmers, also sources Guatemala, Nicaragua, Brazil, Colombia, Uganda. Own roaster installed 2025. Latte art. Breakfast offered.

places.name: Café Nomad
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee focus per multiple sources. Rotating guest roasters and dedicated coffee bar. Eco-conscious (to-go only). Specialty coffee mentioned in 3rd-wave context. No own roastery found.

places.name: Rösterei Bohnenschmiede
places.editorialNote: Own specialty roastery with fair-trade & direct-trade focus. Bio-certified, climate-neutral operations. Offers barista courses and fresh tasting area in-house.

places.name: Wildkaffee am Kurpark
places.editorialNote: Historic coffee roastery since 1892. Sources specialty coffee from around the world (Länderkaffee). Established reputation as genuine specialty roaster in Garmisch-Partenkirchen.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei am Ammersee
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery since 2017. Roasts fresh in small 10kg batches at low temperatures with care. Single origins, rotating blends, espresso focus. Multiple single-origin offerings visible.

places.name: Kaktus - Spezialitätenkaffee
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee shop with own roastery (name explicitly means 'specialty coffee'). Offers espresso blends, omni-roast options, and named single-origin beans. Shop format with beans available.

places.name: Klosterladen
places.editorialNote: Monastery shop with own coffee roastery (Bühners Rhön Kaffee) since 2018. Roasts fresh coffee, sells single-origins and blends. Located in Kloster Maria Bildhausen.

places.name: Hakondo Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery (Manufakturrösterei) producing 100% single-origin highland coffees in long-form roasting. Quality-focused, roasts only highland beans with manual craft process.

places.name: Copenhagen Coffee Lab
places.editorialNote: Danish-owned third-wave roastery with own production. Hand-craft specialty coffee beans roasted in-house. Emphasizes organic & fairtrade. Serves espresso & filter coffee. Bakery on-site.

places.name: Cafe’ del Angel
places.editorialNote: Own coffee roastery with cafe. Focuses on Costa Rican specialty coffee from microlots. Roaster owner sources directly from plantations. Offers tasting courses, brewing method seminars, barista training—clear third-wave commitment.

places.name: Deliano Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own coffee roastery with cafe & online shop. Roasting since 2015 (10-year anniversary in 2025). Drum roasts by hand with master roaster. Sources raw coffee from around world. Multiple brewing method guides. Third-wave hallmarks clear.

places.name: Wasserburger Bohnenröster
places.editorialNote: Coffee roastery & cafe since 2002. Freshly roasted beans, specialty emphasis. Sommelier-trained staff. Careful roasting philosophy ('with pleasure'). Multiple preparation methods. Serves espresso, filter, cold brew.

places.name: Kaffee Pura
places.editorialNote: Own roastery in Giessen specializing in Ethiopian organic (100% Arabica from Sidamo/Yirgacheffe). Bio-certified, direct sourcing, daily fresh roasting. Represents specialty coffee benchmark.

places.name: KOKO COFFEE LAB
places.editorialNote: Specialty-coffee shop emphasizing hand-filter brewing and espresso. Carefully selected beans from Brazil, Ethiopia, Yemen, Central America, India. Roasted in-house. Featured in European Coffee Trip specialty guide.

places.name: Würzburger Partnerkaffee
places.editorialNote: Fair-trade coffee cooperative (est. 1998) with direct relationships to Tanzanian smallholders. Specialty in direct fair-trade, bio-certified, single-origin Ethiopia/Tanzania focus. Listed in German Coffee Association.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei by COMO
places.editorialNote: Own roastery since 2008. Roasts high-quality Arabicas and Robustas (single-origin and blends). Fresh roasting on-site. Coffee store and specialty cafe in historic pedestrian zone. Customers praise strong fresh espresso and owner's bean selection.

places.name: Moccamoor
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery with drum roaster, sources green beans from Hamburg, gentle roasting emphasizing bean character. Part of HEIDEWERK nonprofit supporting people with disabilities.

places.name: Moccamoor
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery with drum roaster, sources green beans from Hamburg, gentle roasting. Serves breakfast, cakes, bagels. Part of social enterprise HEIDEWERK.

places.name: Diers
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery with own patisserie. Owner Diers roasts gourmet and Grand Cru coffees from around the world. In-house baking. Rated #2 of 33 restaurants in Verden.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei pagnia
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery founded 2014 by Thomas and Kristina (roastmasters, baristas, coffeologists). Hand-roasts diverse high-quality coffees. Artisanal approach to all products.

places.name: Kaffeekultur
places.editorialNote: Founded 2000, roastery added 2003. One of few specialty roasteries in Märkischer Kreis region. Hand-roasted single-origins and espresso blends for 25 years. Personalized consultation.

places.name: EOS Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery with 15+ years heritage. Handcrafted drum-roasting. Espresso and filter coffee specialist. Registered in German specialty roasteries directory.

places.name: Wannenmacher's röstfrisch
places.editorialNote: Private roastery & espresso manufaktur. Drum-roasted specialty beans incl. Jamaica Blue Mountain. Two locations: Weststadt roastery + downtown café.

places.name: Kaffeesack
places.editorialNote: Specialty roaster & brewbar. Traditional drum-roasted beans, fresh roasting, trained barista staff. Featured in European Coffee Trip specialty guide.

places.name: Kaffeewelt Schönherr
places.editorialNote: Own roastery (Bad Herrenalber Hochlandmischung, Espresso). Serves regional and Swiss coffees. Siebträger espresso, filter coffee options. Small intimate venue (14 seats).

places.name: BrühHaus
places.editorialNote: Coffee machine retailer with own roastery (seit 18+ Jahren). Team includes certified Baristi, Kaffeesommeliers. Sells own roasts and specialty beans. Kaffeebar on-site.

places.name: Die Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery (Calwer Kaffeerösterei). Specialty single-origins and blends. Fair-trade, sustainable. Fresh langzeitröstung (long roast). Online shop with sortenrein (single-origin) focus.

places.name: Café Goldmund
places.editorialNote: Italian siebträger espresso machine, high-quality bio products. Freshly prepared coffee with expertise and passion. Homemade cake/bread.

places.name: Hot Roasted Love
places.editorialNote: Hot Roasted Love is a specialty coffee roastery in Bielefeld. Direct trade, single-origin arabica, emphasis on transparency. Featured on European Coffee Trip. Own roastery, all beans are specialty grade.

places.name: Kaffeewelt Eisbrenner
places.editorialNote: Kaffeewelt Eisbrenner is an award-winning specialty coffee roastery. Multiple award from Der Feinschmecker, fairtrade certified, focus on single-origin arabicas and quality roasting in traditional drum roaster.

places.name: Deppe & Co
places.editorialNote: Deppe & Co opened a new specialty coffee cafe in 2026 (Und Kaffee) adjacent to original location. Direct specialty coffee focus, dedicated espresso bar, and craft coffee approach evident in social media and recent launch.

places.name: Feinrösterei Monokel
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery in Bodnegg, Germany. Roasts coffee in traditional drum roaster (Trommelröster) with focus on harmony. Bio, fair-trade beans.

places.name: MEE KAFFEE Röstmanufaktur
places.address: Holunderweg 1, 97616 Bad Neustadt an der Saale
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery (Röstmanufaktur) in Bad Neustadt. Friday factory sales. Direct trade and organic certified beans. European specialty coffee roaster.

places.name: Bohnenstolz - Rösterei an der Oberkirche
places.editorialNote: Specialty Coffee Roastery & espresso bar in Arnstadt. Hand-roasted in cast-iron roaster. Single-origin focus, cupping scores, direct relationships with farmers.

places.name: Matz
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery (Kaffeemanufaktur) in Filderstadt. Handcraft small-batch drum roasting with emphasis on single-origin beans, cupping scores, freshness.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Wissmüller
places.editorialNote: Iconic 75-year-old family roastery (est. 1948). Drum roasts 30+ single-origin coffees at 200C for 10-15min. Backyard cafe, SCA-curated selection, traditional German specialty.

places.name: Frankfurter Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: 15+ year specialty roastery operating in Kleinmarkthalle market hall. Listed top-3 third-wave by Yelp. Cafe-bar with market hall atmosphere, strong reputation.

places.name: Nativo Coffee & Shop Rödelheim
places.editorialNote: Peruvian specialty coffee roaster hand-roasted in Berlin. Direct trade, SCA rated >84pts, single-origin arabica. Two Frankfurt locations run by passionate owner. Filter & espresso focus.

places.name: Nativo Coffee & Shop Sachsenhausen
places.editorialNote: Second location of Nativo: Peruvian specialty roaster. Direct trade, SCA rated >84pts, single-origin arabica hand-roasted in Berlin. Same owner, same specialty commitment.

places.name: Nest Coffee
places.editorialNote: Named in Sprudge top coffees guide for Nuremberg. Third-wave coffee shop. Limited web evidence but Yelp 5/5 rating and specialty orientation. Actual roasting status unclear.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Hans Hogrebe
places.editorialNote: Traditional roastery in Cologne since generations. Own roasting, premium beans, expert curation, welcoming family-run shop. Consistently praised for exceptional decaf.

places.name: Coburger Kaffeewerkstatt
places.editorialNote: Cafe Schubart (Coburger Kaffeewerkstatt). Direct-trade Brazilian coffee roasted on-site. Own roastery daily roasting, confectionery, multiple locations in historic Coburg market. Fair-trade, sustainable sourcing.

places.name: ONE Fairtrade Shop
places.editorialNote: Fairtrade coffee roastery with own in-house roasting in historic Lubeck building. Fairtrade-certified, ethical sourcing, drum roasting, specialty focus. Multiple locations (Shop & Altstadtrösterei).

places.name: roest kaffee
places.editorialNote: Colombian specialty coffee roaster. Explicit third-wave focus: pour-over, cold brew, Barista training courses. Roasts fresh in-house since 2017.

places.name: BLAUESHAUSKAFFEE
places.editorialNote: Third-wave specialty roaster. Hand-selected Brazilian beans for signature Schwabacher Goldröstung (famous blend). Slow roasting preserves origin flavors. Sustainable/climate-positive certified.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Parsberg
places.editorialNote: Artisan roaster, 15 years. Hand-selected beans globally sourced. Offers filter, espresso, and single-origin varieties. Transparent sourcing directly from farmers for sustainability.

places.name: Cafésito Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Specialty roaster with inclusive business model. Long-drum roasting 15-22 min (gentle), single-origin coffees, quality-focused. Coffee seminars offered.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Niemeyer
places.editorialNote: Historic award-winning roaster (125 years). Feinschmecker recognized (2005, 2018). Hand-selected Arabicas roasted low-temp on PROBAT drum. Quality hallmark.

places.name: Kivamo Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own roastery with drum-roasting expertise. Fair-trade, specialty-focused blends and single-origins. Barista courses and catering. Espresso and filter coffee with multiple roast levels.

places.name: KYTO Coffee Wuppertal
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roaster with own roastery (Dusseldorf-based chain). Known for specialty-grade espresso, filter coffee with single-origin options. Matcha and pastries also featured.

places.name: Kaffeeküste
places.editorialNote: Own private roastery on the Baltic coast. Fair Trade and organic certified (DE-ÖKO-001). Drum-roasting, cafe with live roasting visible. Handmade roasting recipes.

places.name: House for Coffee
places.editorialNote: Very limited hours (Tue/Thu afternoon only) suggest exclusive operation. Specialty focus indicated but minimal web presence. Appears boutique but details scarce.

places.name: Dresdner Kaffee und Kakao Rösterei
places.editorialNote: Established 1999, drum-roasting with single-origins and blends. 6 Gold medals at German Roasting Guild blind tastings. Named best roastery in Saxony 2018. Barista courses, roastery tours.

places.name: Café Mahlgrad 156
places.editorialNote: Third-wave specialty coffee focused. Small roastery and cafe with excellent espresso and filter coffee. Recognized in European specialty coffee guides.

places.name: Amate Coffee Farm
places.editorialNote: 4th-generation coffee farmer family from Mexico with own plantation. Cup of Excellence winner. 100% organic Arabica, zero-trade model (farm to cup). Sustainable and award-winning.

places.name: Flamingo Kaffee
places.editorialNote: Regional roaster with specialty focus. Offers multiple origin coffees and espresso. Featured in Dresden specialty coffee guides. Known for quality-focused approach.

places.name: Mirella Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: 22-year family roastery. Double drum roasts high-quality beans. Specializes in single-origin coffees with SCA scores 82.75-87 points from Brazil, Central/South America, Africa, Ethiopia.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Röstfreunde
places.editorialNote: Family roastery founded 2015. Award-winning: crema Espresso of the Year 2017 & 2023. Direct trade coffees, gentle drum roasting. Coffee seminars on Saturdays.

places.name: Röstgrad Kaffeemanufaktur
places.editorialNote: Coffee manufactory established 2015. Specializes in hand-roasted coffee rarities and specialty coffees. Limited web presence but shop taxonomy confirms roastery focus.

places.name: Dauner Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Own coffee roastery with direct imports from Ecuador, Peru, Brazil, Mexico, India, Thailand. Fresh-roasted specialty focus, named single origins, espresso and filter options.

places.name: Baristaz Coffee Heroes
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee chain with 'Coffee Heroes' brand. Markets specialty focus, fair-trade, quality coffee, housemade cakes. No own roastery evident but strong specialty positioning and trained baristas.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Nero
places.editorialNote: Own coffee roastery with drum-roasted specialty coffees. Direct/fair-traded from multiple origins (Central America, Africa, Asia). Curated selection, single-origin options, espresso and filter focus.

places.name: Baristaz Coffee Heroes
places.editorialNote: Same chain as Schlossstraße location. Specialty coffee chain with fair-trade positioning, trained baristas, housemade sweets. Strong specialty framing but no own roastery.

places.name: pressoway
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee café on lake with Italian portafilter machine, barista culture, espresso, cold brew, and latte art. 'Best coffee in the world' per reviews.

places.name: CaTienda
places.editorialNote: Dedicated Kaffeebar und Röstwerkstatt (coffee bar and roastery) with traditional drum roasting. Direct trade single-origin beans from Brazil, Peru, Central America, Africa. Barista courses, latte art, filter brewing methods.

places.name: Da Roberto Kaffeemanufaktur (Rösterei)
places.editorialNote: Coffee roastery and manufactory. German roaster with own roasting facility. Limited web visibility on specialty credentials.

places.name: Fellner finest Coffee
places.editorialNote: Gentle long-drum roasting, Direct Trade focus, parcel coffees (Parzellenkaffee). Manual roasting approach emphasizing single-origin quality.

places.name: Kaffeemanufaktur Brennpunkt
places.editorialNote: Kaffeemanufaktur specializing in long-time roasting (Langzeitröstung) with organic certification (DE-ÖKO-006). Artisanal approach emphasizing quality beans and proper roasting.

places.name: mi...Café & Bar
places.editorialNote: Cafe & bar emphasizing coffee as passion with no compromises. Sources carefully selected beans from regional roastery in Hesse. Focus on aromatic specialty coffee specialties.

places.name: Dietrichs Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Specialty roastery offering microlots and specialty coffee. Traditional drum roasting. Located in historic Schubertmühle. 35 years experience. Offers café and farm shop (Hofladen).

places.name: Eberts Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Bio-certified coffee roastery (DE-ÖKO-037) with ~80 varieties of coffee, tea, spices. Owner is certified coffeesommelier trained in Vienna. Gentle drum roasting of premium beans.

places.name: Ferdinands Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Traditional Langzeitröstung roastery (20-25 min at 240°C). Single-origin and blended Arabica from Central/South America and Africa. Fair trade, direct farmer contact.

places.name: boni Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: SCA-scored specialty coffee roastery (80+ points). Direct trade, transparent sourcing from Peru, Ethiopia, Kenya, El Salvador. Multiple roast styles. Sustainability focus.

places.name: Kaffeezimmer
places.editorialNote: Specialty Coffeebar und Rösterei. Fresh-roasted coffee, artisanal preparation with latte art, specialty-focused menu. Featured in European Coffee Trip guide.

places.name: CONTIGO Fairtrade Shop
places.editorialNote: Fairtrade specialty coffee roastery and cafe. Bio-certified beans roasted in-house from 8 different origin countries. Fair trade commitment. Coffee bar serves prepared specialties. Also sells ethical goods.

places.name: RöstRaum
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery with cafe. Small operation (Brewfactory GbR) since Aug 2020. Own drum roasting of fine single-origin beans with conscious sourcing. Roastery at Alte Kasseler Str 27, cafe Thu-Sat 12-17h. Focus on craft roasting and proper extraction.

places.name: Weidenhäuser Kaffeerösterei & Café Il Gusto
places.editorialNote: Traditional hand-roasting coffee roastery with cafe since 2014. Specialty coffee focus. Coffees from Africa, Asia, Central and Latin America. Drum-roasted, fair trade, sustainable sourcing. Cafe serves espresso and filter. Roastery open Wed 15-18h, Sat 11-14h. Barista-trained staff.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery since 2012. Instagram confirms 'specialty coffee roaster'. Handcrafted drum roasting. Cafe serves espresso, filter, and food. International single-origin beans. Noted for quality on Tripadvisor and specialty coffee databases.

places.name: Café Küstenkind
places.editorialNote: Own coffee roastery, passionate about origin and flavor. Serves breakfast, cakes, vegan options. Instagram shows barista-driven espresso and filter focus.

places.name: Kaffeerösterei Sylt
places.editorialNote: Own roastery in converted warehouse at Rantum harbor. Christian Appel roasts and serves coffee from own production, operates online shop. Documented in specialty coffee guides.

places.name: Kostbar
places.editorialNote: Small cozy café with coffee from around the world and homemade cakes. TripAdvisor 4.7/5 rate. Strong coffee focus, potential third-wave indicators, but limited detail on sourcing/roasting.

places.name: Paul Heyck's Kaffeerösterei und Teehandlung
places.editorialNote: Historic roastery since 1840. Sources rare single-origins with cultural heritage focus, including Indonesian Toraja beans. Emphasizes quality and traditional cultivation methods.

places.name: Loppokaffee
places.editorialNote: Member of Roasters United. Direct-trade model sourcing organic beans exclusively from cooperatives. Annual farm visits for traceability. Focus on sustainability and quality improvement.

places.name: Café Hilda
places.editorialNote: Own roastery under affiliated brand Kopiton. In-house roasting with emphasis on quality. Offers filter coffee, cappuccino, and cold drip brewing methods.

places.name: Loppokaffee
places.editorialNote: Second location of Loppokaffee. Member of Roasters United with direct-trade model, organic sourcing, and sustainability focus. Same standards as main roastery.

places.name: Roest Space
places.editorialNote: Specialty roaster emphasizing single-origin beans and unique flavor profiles. Light roasting to preserve natural aromas. Highlights origin factors, elevation, and processing methods. Fresh roasting every Tuesday.

places.name: Contains Coffee Roasters
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery in Munich metro. Explicit 'Speciality Grade' declaration. Single-origin espressos/filters, education/cupping program.

places.name: Spezialitäten Rösterei Winzer
places.editorialNote: Specialty coffee roastery with hand-roasting focus. Emphasizes origin traceability, sustainable sourcing, handcraft roasting with Giesen equipment.

places.name: genießBAR
places.editorialNote: Part of Kaffeewerk Zollernalb, a specialty roastery with German Roasting Guild membership, traditional drum roasting, award-winning (gold + 2 silver medals). Offers ~30 varieties including single-origins from highland regions; committed to sustainability & fairness.

places.name: Wiedenbrücker Kaffeekontor
places.editorialNote: Professional specialty café with SCAE-certified barista, serves beans from regional drum roasters, offers barista training courses. Committed to coffee education & craft. Small lively space with art events.

places.name: Mela Cafe
places.editorialNote: Café with roastery focus, sources fair-trade certified beans directly from small farmers (Honduras). Emphasis on sustainability & single-origin coffee from known suppliers. Offers varied breakfast menu, cozy seating.

places.name: Wilde Kuh
places.editorialNote: Small café serving specialty coffee from Kaffeekultur Fulda roastery. Focuses on organic/regional products with craft coffee. Part of regional 'wertfoll' network of quality businesses. Offers bio-coffee & sandwiches with Demeter cheese.

places.name: Guntiaroma Kaffeerösterei
